faq: How much does Gamma cost?

Free is $0. Billed yearly, Plus is $9/month ($108 a year), Pro is $18/month ($216 a year) and Ultra is $90/month ($1,080 a year). Gamma says yearly billing saves up to 28% compared to monthly billing.
What are Gamma AI credits?

Credits are used for AI features throughout Gamma. The number an action uses depends on what you are doing, which AI model is used and the length or complexity of the generation. Plus includes 1,500 a month, Pro 4,000 and Ultra 20,000.
Do unused Gamma credits roll over?
Yes, up to 2 times the monthly amount. For example, Plus can hold up to 3,000 credits.
Is Gamma free?
Yes. The Free plan includes 400 credits at signup that do not refill, up to 10 slides per prompt, and export to PDF, PPTX, PNG and Google Slides.

faq: Is {tool} free forever?

The Free plan has no time limit and is not a trial. Only the credits run out: AI actions use up the 400 credits you get at signup, and they do not refill. Without credits you can still edit your gammas by hand.
How do I get more {tool} credits for free?
Refer friends. You get 200 credits for each friend who signs up with your link, and a Free account can hold up to 2,000 credits at once. Referrals are only for Free users.
Can I buy {tool} credits on the Free plan?
No. Free users cannot buy credits. Buying credits needs a paid plan such as {paid}, and starts at {cur}6 for 1,500 credits.

faq: How many credits does a {tool} presentation use?

{tool} does not publish a fixed number. Create with AI counts credits per slide and per image, so longer decks and more images use more, and advanced AI models may use more than standard ones. {tool} does not yet show how many credits each gamma used.
What happens when I run out of {tool} credits?

You can still edit your gammas by hand and use every feature that is not AI. On Free you can earn 200 credits per friend you refer, or upgrade. On a paid plan you can buy more credits or wait for your monthly refill on your billing date.
What happens to my credits if I cancel?
When the paid plan ends, your account moves to Free and your plan credits reset to 400. Credits you bought separately stay for one year after you cancel.
